The text concerns questions related to the *Chaddantajātaka* (Ja 514) and the *Ghaṭikāra Sutta* (MN 81), both of which are cited as key references for the discussion [SuttaCentral]. Three modern translations in three languages are recorded on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
